name: crash-recovery
title: Resume a crashed run from its event log

origin.source: Event-log recovery after a simulated process crash

comparison.purpose: Writes an article in two steps, journals every accepted input through `onEvent`, and resumes from the log alone — recorded model calls are replayed, and the in-flight one re-executes under the same `info.callKey`.

starters: the history of the fax machine
